undeclared_policy.quote: If you’re still deciding on a major, or you’re considering options across multiple colleges, University Exploratory Advising is built for you. You’ll be paired with an Academic & Career Exploration (ACE) Coach who helps you explore majors, plan your courses, and use Vol Core (general education) to make progress while you decide. Most University Exploratory students declare a major by 45 attempted credit hours.
